messages:
Kira: Hey folks — kinda nervous to share but also excited: three quick updates! 1) I accepted a PhD offer at UBC (starting this fall) 🎓 2) I got promoted to Senior Staff Engineer, starting next week 🎉 3) We’re expecting a baby in late September 👶 Very grateful and a little overwhelmed. Not looking for anything formal, just wanted to share the happy chaos. —Kira
Sam: Kira!!! this is AMAZING. congrats on all of it :tada::heart_eyes: totally deserved for the promo and the PhD is wild in the best way. when should we celebrate?
Noor: omg congrats times three. we need cake. are you around next Wednesday or Friday for a mini surprise in the lounge? 
Priya: Huge congrats Kira!! ❤️ Would love to help organize. I can do Friday afternoon.
Eli: Wow wow wow. congrats. if you want a low-key thing we can do a 15-min toast during retro and ship cupcakes to remote folks?
Kira: Thank you all <3 I’m around both days but Friday afternoon feels less hectic for me. low-key is perfect — cupcakes + a quick toast works.
Maeve: Friday works for me. Should we do 3 options so remote folks can vote too? I can drop a small poll thread for cake flavor/transport.
Asha: I’ll be remote that day but can join video for the toast. also happy to coordinate a small group card + gift from people-ops budget if that’s ok? :blush:
people-ops-bot: @people-ops request received: small celebratory gift and card for Kira. Please confirm gift amount. (auto-reply)
Priya: Suggestion: 1) Friday 4/2 3:30pm PST 2) Friday 4/2 4:30pm PST 3) Friday 4/2 lunchtime 12:30pm PST. Also flavors: vanilla, chocolate, lemon. emoji-react with 1/2/3 and :vanilla:, :chocolate_bar:, :lemon: for flavors?
Sam: reacting with 2 and :chocolate_bar: :)
Noor: 2 + :vanilla: from me (also will bring a non-dairy option)
Eli: 1 + :lemon: (if enough lemon, i volunteer to fetch from the cafe)
Maeve: 2 + :chocolate_bar: 
Kira: I vote 2 and chocolate (thanks everyone!!) Also tiny request — if anyone wants to say a few words, no pressure, keep it <1 minute — would be sweet.
Asha: I can say something over video. happy to coordinate card signatures too.
people-ops-bot: people-ops confirmed: budget approved for celebratory gift (up to $120). Please DM @people-ops if you'd like to contribute personally.
Sam: who else should we invite? keep it to ~10 in-person to stay cozy?
Priya: Let’s invite the eng-runtime folks and a couple PMs who work closely with Kira. I’ll add an invite list in a follow-up thread.
Eli: Quick logistics note — lounge bookings: use #office-calendar. I’ll book the lounge for 4:15–4:45 to give time for setup and a quick toast.
Kira: This is so lovely — thank you. Don’t feel like you all need to do anything huge. Really appreciate the support. ❤️
Maeve: Posted a tiny RSVP poll in #random-polls for remote folks. Will paste link here: https://slack-redwood/example/poll/2498765432 (vote!)
Sam: Added a little GIF to the calendar invite :party_parrot:
Noor: Congrats again — triple threat Kira! we’ll make it fun and short.
people-ops-bot: reminder scheduled: send calendar reminder 24 hours before event.
Kira: ok signing off to read a 100-page long PhD offer email. thanks friends ❤️
